data.title: Electricity contract confirmation "MusterStrom Flex"
data.summary: Stadtwerke Musterstadt GmbH confirmed your electricity supply contract "MusterStrom Flex" for Beispielweg 5, starting 1 October 2025 with a 12-month initial term. The monthly advance payment is €48.00, collected by direct debit on the 15th.
data.explanation: This confirms your new electricity contract. It has an initial term of 12 months, ending 30 September 2026. It can be cancelled with one month's notice to the end of that term, so the app calculates the cancellation deadline. If you don't cancel, it continues indefinitely and can then be cancelled at any time with one month's notice. Cancellation needs text form, such as an email, or the portal button. The €48.00 advance payment is collected automatically by direct debit. Please report your meter reading at the start of supply by 5 October 2025. Check that the bank account for direct debit is correct.
